title: Container height and intrinsic sizes
units: CSS px, physical, relative to the container border box; box is getBoundingClientRect (the border box); lines are unions of Ahem glyph rects per block container

h-root.note: the flow-root container grows to a 50x80 float

h-plain-child.note: a plain child does not grow to its float

h-empty-child.note: a child holding only a float has height 0; later text wraps around the float

h-flow-root.note: a flow-root child grows to its float

h-overflow.note: a overflow child grows to its float

h-inline-block.note: a inline-block child grows to its float

h-abspos.note: a abspos child grows to its float

h-float.note: a float child grows to its float

h-table-cell.note: a table-cell child grows to its float

h-flex-item.note: a flex-item child grows to its float

h-float-margin.note: float with margin-block-end 15: the container includes the margin

h-float-neg-margin-all.note: float with margin-block-end -40 (margin box below zero)

h-min-block.note: flow-root child with min-block-size 20 and a 50-tall float

h-max-block.note: flow-root child with max-block-size 20 and a 50-tall float

h-clearfix-div.note: a plain child with a trailing clear:both div grows past its float

h-clearfix-margin.note: the trailing clear div has margin-block-start 10

h-inline-block-width.note: shrink-to-fit inline-block holding a 60 float and "aa bb"

h-min-content.note: min-content width of a flow-root holding a 60 float and "aa bb"

h-max-content.note: max-content width of a flow-root holding left 60, right 40 and "aa bb"

h-max-content-cleared.note: max-content width with cleared floats: the widest row, not the sum

h-max-content-block.note: max-content width: a float then a block child with text

h-max-content-bfc-child.note: max-content width: a float then a flow-root child with text

h-float-auto-in-inline-block.note: a shrink-to-fit float inside a shrink-to-fit inline-block
